Braised beef with squash

main dish Soups and stew Autumn
Total: PT1H30M | Active: PT20M

Ingredients

Stew

oil for frying
400 g beef ragout
2 tsp hot paprika
1 tsp ground cumin
0.75 tsp salt
2 onions, thinly sliced
2 garlic cloves, squeezed
5 dl meat bouillon

To finish

600 g squash (e.g. red kuri), cut into approx. 2 cm pieces
100 g sour single cream
0.5 bunch flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped
